subject: Invoice discrepancy: duplicate compute line items / proposed credit
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@astraltech.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice discrepancy — duplicate compute line items

Hi Priyom,

We just received the June invoice and noticed two identical 'gke-us-east compute' line items that doubled our compute charge for the week of June 7–13. Total impact on our invoice is $4,200 before VAT. Attached is the invoice PDF marked up with the two line items highlighted.

Please let us know how this happened and what remediation you can offer. Our finance team needs a corrected invoice and confirmation of any VAT handling as soon as possible — we have month-end close on Friday.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Finance Lead, AstralTech Inc.
[Attachment: astral_invoice_jun2026.pdf (PDF, 325 KB)]
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Rao <priya@astraltech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice discrepancy — duplicate compute line items

Hi Priya — thanks for flagging this and for the annotated invoice. I'm really sorry for the hassle. I've looped in Monica (your account lead) and Ben (billing ops) so we can get a corrective action plan in place.

Proposed next steps:
- Ben to validate the back-end billing records and confirm whether the duplication is a billing engine misclassification or a reporting display issue.
- If an overcharge is confirmed, we'll issue a credit note and an adjusted invoice showing VAT treatment.
- Separately, we'll offer a one-time goodwill credit for the operational impact while we fix the pipeline.

Ben/Monica — can you pick this up? Priya, we aim to provide a formal remediation and credit note within 48 hours. If you'd prefer a direct refund instead of account credit, please let us know.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice discrepancy — duplicate compute line items (investigation)

Folks — I pulled the usage and billing logs for AstralTech for the period in question. Summary of findings:

- Root cause: a regional routing regression in the batching pipeline duplicated a subset of requests that were tagged both 'gke-us-east' and 'gke-us-east-2' for customers with cross-zone routing enabled. The dedup logic failed for a ~6-hour window on 2026-06-09 UTC.
- Impact: duplicate compute charges totaling $4,200. Tax/VAT applied on top of that per AstralTech's billing profile (VAT registered in US state).
- Recommended remediation: issue a credit note for $4,200 plus reverse the VAT on the credit note so AstralTech can reconcile with their records. We'll also generate an adjusted invoice (shows original charge, credit note, net due $0).

Attached: INVOICE-ADJ-20260622.pdf (draft adjusted invoice) and a CSV extract of the affected line items.

Policy question: do we also include a goodwill service credit for the disruption? Historically for errors >$2k we offer a small goodwill concession (flat $250–$1,000 depending on customer tier). AstralTech is a mid-enterprise account — I recommend $500 goodwill credit.

I'll prepare the credit note and the accounting entries once Priyom/Monica confirm the amount and whether AstralTech prefers account credit vs refunded payment.

— Ben
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: INVOICE-ADJ-20260622.pdf (PDF, 48 KB), affected_lines_astraltech_0609.csv (CSV, 12 KB)]
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice discrepancy — next steps and tax handling

Monica / Ben — quick internal:

- Agree with Ben's root cause and remediation approach.
- For VAT/tax: since AstralTech is requesting a corrected invoice for month-end, we should issue a formal credit note that mirrors the $4,200 adjustment and shows VAT reversed. That gives their finance team the accounting paper trail they need.
- Goodwill: offer $500 as a one-time account credit (not taxable). This helps rebuild trust and is consistent with our playbook.
- Payment method: ask the customer which they prefer (refund to card vs account credit). For speed, account credit is fastest to apply; refunds require payment ops and can take 5–7 business days.

Ben — please produce the credit note and adjusted invoice and attach to the reply to the customer. Monica — I'll let you present the goodwill offer to Priya.

Thanks,
Priyom
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Rao <priya@astraltech.com>, AstralTech Finance <finance@astraltech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Resolution: adjusted invoice and credit note for June charges

Hi Priya / AstralTech Finance team —

Thanks again for the heads up. We've completed our investigation and confirmed a billing engine duplication that produced the two compute line items on the June invoice. Below is what we propose as remediation: 

1) Corrective credit note: $4,200 credit to reverse the duplicate compute charges. The credit note reverses the VAT associated with those lines so the net accounting is correct. Attached: credit_note_astral_20260622.pdf and adjusted_invoice_20260622.pdf.

2) Goodwill: we will apply a one-time account credit of $500 for operational inconvenience (non-taxable). This will appear on your account as a separate line and can be applied to future invoices.

3) Timing & method:
   - If you prefer an account credit, we will apply it within 1 business day after you confirm.
   - If you prefer a refund to the original payment method, please confirm and we will kick off payment ops (refund ETA 5–7 business days).

4) Acceptance: if you can reply with your preference (account credit vs refund) we will proceed. If you need a signed acceptance for your internal AR, you can sign the attached DocuSign envelope here: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/view?rb=doc-9abc123

We apologize for the error and the impact on your month-end close. Separately, we've deployed the fix to the routing/dedup logic to prevent recurrence and will follow up with a short post-mortem next week.

Best regards,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Cc: Monica Patel (Account Lead), Ben Carter (Billing Ops)
[Attachments: credit_note_astral_20260622.pdf (PDF, 22 KB), adjusted_invoice_20260622.pdf (PDF, 46 KB)]
